added.member: scene, prefab and table author schemas
added.summary: Tooling can bind typed scene/prefab shells to project component/resource layouts and table rows to a fixed record. Closed fields, recursive entities, prefab edits, streaming and stable ordered row ids generate readonly TS contracts. All table columns may be omitted; decoding preserves omissions for later canonical-default normalization. Context-dependent kinds are not registered as context-free factories. This establishes structural contracts only; formats, parsers, graph semantics and persistence are unchanged.
